# `oira_meetings`

**OIRA EO 12866 meetings**

OIRA's Executive Order 12866 meeting log: meetings OIRA held with outside parties about rules under review, ingested from reginfo.gov bulk XML exports via `spicy_docs.sources.oira` and `build_oira_meetings`. One row per log entry (requesting organization and contact for a meeting on a rule). Keyed by `rin` for joining to `oira_reviews`, `unified_agenda`, and `federal_register`. Each downloaded Cp1252 XML original is retained once in the shared raw archive and referenced by `source_sha256`.

**Coverage.** Window. RegInfo.gov currently publishes EO 12866 meeting logs in bulk XML only for the first and second halves of 2024 (`source_file` names the export and `source_sha256` pins its retained bytes); other years exist only in reginfo.gov's interactive HTML search. Rebuilt in full on each run. *(measured 2026-11-25)*

- **Parquet file:** `oira_meetings.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `meeting_id` | `VARCHAR` | RegInfo.gov meeting identifier. Present on second-half 2024 rows; omitted (null) in the first-half 2024 export. |
| `rin` | `VARCHAR` | Regulation Identifier Number of the rule discussed. Join key to `oira_reviews`, `unified_agenda`, and `federal_register`. |
| `agency_code` | `VARCHAR` | Acronym of the agency that owns the RIN, matching `unified_agenda.agency_code`. |
| `agency_name` | `VARCHAR` | Full name of the agency that owns the RIN from reginfo.gov's agency list. Null when absent. |
| `title` | `VARCHAR` | Title of the rule discussed. |
| `rule_stage` | `VARCHAR` | Rulemaking stage at the time of the meeting (e.g. `Proposed Rule Stage`, `Final Rule Stage`). |
| `meeting_date` | `VARCHAR` | Date of the meeting (ISO `YYYY-MM-DD`). |
| `meeting_status` | `VARCHAR` | `Completed`, `Scheduled`, or `No Show`. |
| `requestor_organization` | `VARCHAR` | Organization that requested the meeting (HTML entities unescaped once; original bytes pinned by `source_sha256`). |
| `requestor_name` | `VARCHAR` | Contact person for the requesting organization. |
| `summary` | `VARCHAR` | Meeting summary when OIRA recorded one; typically null in the bulk XML export. |
| `source_file` | `VARCHAR` | RegInfo.gov XML export file name that supplied the row (e.g. `EO_12866_Meeting_Data_First_Half_2024.xml`). |
| `source_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | SHA-256 digest (`sha256:<hex>`) of the retained RegInfo.gov XML export that supplied the row. |
| `url` | `VARCHAR` | RegInfo.gov meeting detail page URL listing attendees and handout documents; null when `meeting_id` is null. |
